fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg grain-storage registration
fields.contract: ArgentSeaPgSiloBuilderExtensions (namespace Orleans.Hosting) registers grain storage under a provider name: AddArgentSeaPgDbOrleansGrainStorage(builder, name[, Action<OrleansDbPersistenceOptions>]) and AddArgentSeaPgShardOrleansGrainStorage(builder, name[, Action<OrleansShardPersistenceOptions>]) return the builder; the IServiceCollection overloads take an Action<OptionsBuilder<...>> and return the collection. Each applies its options to the options named for the provider and registers a keyed IGrainStorage built by ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory: CreateDb yields ArgentSeaDbGrainPersistence<PgDbConnectionOptions> over the PgDatabases singleton, CreateShards yields ArgentSeaShardGrainPersistence<PgShardConnectionOptions> over the PgShardSets singleton, each reading the options named for the provider. The method names carry Pg so they never collide with ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql's extensions in the same namespace.
